booking_url_status: GlossGenius indexes this URL under the business's real name (confirmed via Google search snippet: title 'Lash Mastery & Aesthetics Co.' for lashmama.glossgenius.com/), and Fresha's own listing cross-references it as this business's websiteUrl. However, live automated fetches of the URL during this research session (curl, WebFetch, r.jina.ai reader, from multiple CloudFront edges) all received a 302 redirect to the generic glossgenius.com marketing homepage instead of the tenant page, both with and without trailing slash and on /book /services /about paths. This blocked scripts/glossgenius_dossier.py (menu/prices/photos/email could not be extracted). The link is still used as the real booking CTA since it is the business's documented real channel; it may simply be intermittently unavailable to automated fetchers.
has_own_site_check: Searched '"Lash Mastery" Aesthetics Boca Raton website' and variants; no independent domain found. Only presence is lashmama.glossgenius.com (booking, platform subdomain) plus aggregator/directory listings (Fresha, Birdeye, Atly, LashLookup, Hotfrog, Facebook page). No <business>.com or similar found.
instagram_note: Automated photo pull (scripts/ig_photos.py, both the Railway service and local Playwright fallback) returned only 1 image reliably from the feed. Supplemented via imginn.com (public IG mirror) which surfaced 13 real feed images; after visual curation (excluding stock-style promo graphics with text overlay, a selfie, an unrelated travel photo, and closed-eye tweezer mid-procedure macro shots per the gate's photo rules) 6 were used across hero/about/gallery/avatar.
brand_vibe: No strong branded interior photography was recovered (GlossGenius blocked; IG feed mostly macro lash/brow close-ups on neutral backgrounds, one black-background gold-text promo graphic, one pink-toned salon selfie backdrop). Chose a NEW palette not used by other recently-processed lash & brow businesses (mixnminxlashes = gold/black, etherealeyelashesfl = gold/ivory, belezalash = cream/mocha, lashesdeve = wine/black, lashbloom = blush/pink, browbabes = terracotta/ivory): a warm bronze/taupe-on-near-black palette (bg #120e0c, ink #f4ece0, accent-deep #b08a5c, accent-mid #cba97e), derived from templates/dark-v2 (pureartistry skeleton) by anchored hex/rgb substitution. Merktop badge left gold per spec.

Followed the pipeline guidance to show fewer good photos rather than backfill with weaker ones.
